---
applyTo: "docs/research/**,docs/validation/**"
---

When editing research or validation material:
- distinguish observed evidence, inference, hypothesis, and acceptance decision;
- include provenance and reproduction conditions;
- do not imply production adoption from a research result;
- do not mark V1 accepted unless the documented multi-day acceptance gate has actually passed;
- prefer falsifiers and boundary cases over broad qualitative claims.
